name: Geigers Posthotel
beschreibung:
Centrally located in sun-drenched Serfaus, Geigers Posthotel offers premium guestrooms, a relaxing spa area, and superb regional cuisine. It is a wonderful retreat for families and mountain lovers.

The Serfaus Dorfbahn underground, mountain cable cars across Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, and hiking routes are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Geigers Posthotel in Serfaus combines alpine comfort, spa wellness, and heartfelt hospitality on the sunny plateau.
